command:
set -u
client=
if command -v mariadb >/dev/null 2>&1; then client=$(command -v mariadb)
elif command -v mysql >/dev/null 2>&1; then client=$(command -v mysql)
fi
printf 'node=%s\n' "${NODE_NAME:-unknown}"
printf 'client=%s\n' "$client"
if [ -n "$client" ]; then
  "$client" --version 2>&1 | head -1
fi
printf 'sudo_uid='
sudo -n -H id -u 2>&1
for p in /root/.my.cnf /etc/mysql/debian.cnf /etc/mysql/my.cnf /etc/mysql/mariadb.cnf; do
  if sudo -n -H test -e "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'protected_config=%s ' "$p"
    if sudo -n -H test -r "$p" 2>/dev/null; then printf 'readable=yes '; else printf 'readable=no '; fi
    sudo -n -H stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U' "$p" 2>/dev/null
  fi
done
if [ -z "$client" ]; then
  printf 'auth_method=unavailable\n'
  exit 0
fi
out=$(sudo -n -H "$client" --protocol=socket --batch --skip-column-names -e 'SELECT @@version' 2>&1)
rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf 'auth_method=privileged_local_socket\n'
  printf 'auth_probe=%s\n' "$out"
else
  printf 'privileged_local_socket_rc=%s\n' "$rc"
  printf 'privileged_local_socket_error=%s\n' "$out"
  for p in /etc/mysql/debian.cnf /root/.my.cnf; do
    if sudo -n -H test -r "$p" 2>/dev/null; then
      out=$(sudo -n -H "$client" --defaults-extra-file="$p" --protocol=socket --batch --skip-column-names -e 'SELECT @@version' 2>&1)
      rc=$?
      if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
        printf 'auth_method=protected_defaults:%s\n' "$p"
        printf 'auth_probe=%s\n' "$out"
        break
      else
        printf 'protected_defaults=%s rc=%s error=%s\n' "$p" "$rc" "$out"
      fi
    fi
  done
fi
